inputs.text: [upset] We can't leave her like that. She's still reaching for someone. If I can get my wand clear, I can try to break the ice.
[worried] And if you stop beside her, I'll have two people I can't get out. Watch your heel. Look at what's happening to it.
[upset] It was doing the same thing to me. I didn't even feel it. I was going to stand right there.
[worried] You saw someone who needed help. I'm not telling you that was wrong. I'm telling you the floor doesn't care why you stop.
[upset] Do you think I don't understand that? I understand it. I just don't know how to walk away while she's looking at us.
[worried] I don't know how to help her yet. I wish I had something better to say, but I don't. We need to find what's doing this.
[upset] Then that's what we're doing. We're not finding a door and pretending we didn't see her. If we get a chance, we go back.
[worried] If we can reach her without being caught ourselves, yes. But don't pull away from me without telling me. I nearly lost you just then.
